movie_review.observation: Bright round cells remain visible across the escalating shear-condition montage, with changed positions between sampled frames. This is consistent with the source-described control rolling behavior; no velocities or rolling counts were remeasured.

P1 label is visible. Bright round cells appear in early low-shear fields and become sparse in later high-shear fields. Montage changes field of view. This is qualitatively consistent with the source-described adhesion defect; sampling does not quantify velocity or prove absence of every interaction.

P2 label is visible. Bright cells occur during low-shear segments; later high-shear fields show few such cells. All five labels and the final frame were inspected. This supports the scope of the source-described cell assay, not developmental-severity inference.
